extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to The Helen Hay Whitney Foundation research fellowship (potential postdoctoral fellows)
extracted.subtask_description: Key procedural dates and timing requirements for applying to and beginning a Helen Hay Whitney Foundation Research Fellowship, including application availability, deadlines, interview schedule, committee decisions, and activation/start dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online application availability
rubrics_metrics.description: April 24, 2026 (5:00pm EST) — Online application form becomes available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marks the earliest date/time applicants may access and begin the Foundation's application form. Applicants should plan to use the form after this date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application receipt deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: June 15, 2026 (5:00pm EST) — Applications must be received by the Foundation no later than 5:00pm EST, June 15, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hard deadline: the Foundation must receive the complete application by the stated date and time. Late or postmarked-after submissions are not acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant status notification (initial)
rubrics_metrics.description: Early-mid October — All applicants will be advised by email of their status (declined or approved for interview).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should monitor email in early to mid-October for notification; this communication indicates whether they will be advanced to the interview stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal interviews for selected applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: October — Personal interviews take place for applicants who have been so selected by the Scientific Advisory Committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interviews occur in October for those approved by the Scientific Advisory Committee; selection for interview is communicated earlier by email. Applicants should be prepared to attend if selected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific Advisory Committee review and selection meeting
rubrics_metrics.description: November 13, 2026 — Scientific Advisory Committee meets to review all personal interview reports and applications. At this meeting, Fellows are chosen from among the interviewed candidates and recommended for approval by the Board of Trustees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final selection of Fellows is made at this meeting based on interview reports and application materials; recommendations are forwarded to the Board for approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of committee decisions to interviewed applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: November 16, 2026 — All interviewed applicants are notified of the Scientific Advisory Committee’s decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interviewed applicants will receive notice of the Committee’s decisions on this date; expect formal communication shortly thereafter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earliest possible fellowship starting date
rubrics_metrics.description: April 1, 2027 — Earliest possible fellowship starting date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the earliest date a awarded fellowship may commence; awardees should plan start logistics accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship activation deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: All fellowships must be activated by September 1, 2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mandatory activation cutoff: any fellowship not activated by this date will presumably forfeit the award or require special arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-year Fellow presentation at Annual Meeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Potential Fellows should also be aware that in November, at the Annual Meeting of Fellows, each third-year Fellow presents the results of his or her research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program expectation for Fellows in their third year: prepare a research presentation for the Foundation’s November Annual Meeting.
